title: Train your CNN on MNIST
hints: Work through the numbered steps in the starter code in order. Every step is one or two calls to functions already in your library.

A training step: for each index in the batch, add cnn_gradients(...) into a running total (and cnn_forward + cross_entropy_loss for the reported loss). Then divide by the batch size and gd_step each parameter with its slice of the averaged gradient.

The gradient vector is laid out as [conv_w (72) | conv_b (8) | dense_w (13,520, row-major) | dense_b (10)]. Slice it at 72, 80 and 13,600. Flatten dense_w before its gd_step and reshape it back to 10 × 1352 afterwards.
